oracle.name: Dataverse classic workflows (designer XAML through the Web API)
oracle.scope: Six designer-format classic workflows (real-time as owner and as calling user, background with update, create, set state, Stop Succeeded and Canceled, a failing create step, a wait on a column and a wait on the current time) on an invented two-table schema, each scenario one primary row created on behalf of a work account: the create's answer, the workflow system jobs, the workflow log rows, the rows the workflows wrote and the primary row. Hosted session F6, runs A and B.
